description: Daily precipitation over Copenhagen from 1940 to 2025 (Open-Meteo's ERA5 archive) and each year's wettest day. Statistics idea: extreme values. The maximum of many days follows an extreme-value distribution: a Gumbel fit (method of moments) to the 86 annual maxima gives return levels, the rain expected once in 10, 50 or 100 years on average, with Kite's 95% interval. Caveats: a reanalysis grid cell smooths cloudbursts (2 July 2011: over 100 mm at city stations, 20 mm in ERA5), a 100-year level extrapolates beyond the data, and the fit assumes a stable climate (the two halves of the record are fitted separately to compare).
name: Copenhagen's wettest days
